known_boundaries.detail: The original example places its opaque Background above Animated Disc in the top-first layer model. All five TS reference frames are uniformly RGBA [48,63,97,255]. Preserve this existing output; the case does not establish visible animation or sequence identity. Generated moving scenes and real media sequences provide independent coverage.
The current TS sidecar rejects EXR. Real linear EXR bytes are retained for native decoder coverage; M0 does not claim a TS EXR reference.
The current TS effect compiler maps path masks to ellipse parameters. The path case claims schema coverage only; ellipse and rectangle have independent real mask cases.
Point-light shadows are not implemented by the TS path; directional and spot fixtures provide actual shadow coverage.
Capture must reject renderer diagnostics, media registry failures, unloaded plugin requests and audio-analysis decode warnings rather than accepting successful readback as resource correctness.

Precomposition textureCount is the existing full-resolution target budget (two per plain surface, five with effects), not the total GPUTexture allocation count. Effect pyramids and identity LUTs are outside that count; pyramid storage is included in estimated bytes. The repaired count guard and cache preserve the existing 20-target, pixel, byte and depth limits.
